leaders.name: Nina Ward
leaders.title: Supervisor of Elections
leaders.notes: Base salary under Ch. 145, F.S.; officers who complete the statutory certification program may receive up to $2,000/yr special qualification salary on top (not included). FY25-26 office budget line 5101100 'Supervisor of Election Salary' = $171,000 (prior year $160,000). Appointed May 2024, elected 2024 (source 3).

department_totals.notes: salaries = Supervisor salary $171,000 + regular wages $639,960; election_temp_wages = poll workers $92,008.50 + election temps $45,050 + early voting $87,222; benefits = FICA + retirement + insurance + workers comp + re-employment tax. Total compensation $1,545,586.94.

department_totals.department: Supervisor of Elections - FY2027 BOCC funding
department_totals.notes: FY2027 BOCC 'Fees & Cost-Sup Of Elect' transfer (plus $1,064,538 equipment and $213,012 facility costs carried by the BOCC). The SOE's own FY2026-27 budget detail was not posted as of 2026-10-21.

gaps: SOE FY2026-27 approved budget not posted (site still shows 'Current Budget 2025-2026'). Request: 'SOE FY2026-27 approved budget with personnel detail'.
No SOE pay plan or staff salaries online. Request: 'SOE position roster with job title and annual salary as of 10/1/2026'. Number of regular positions is not stated in the posted budget.
